prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: hero illustration for an introductory DML and DMX documentation storybook. Create an original illustration in the gentle watercolor and fine ink storybook aesthetic associated with The Little Prince: a curious small traveler with tousled golden hair, a long warm saffron scarf and a sage green coat, standing on a tiny round sandy planet under an expansive ivory-paper sky. Around the traveler float three small worlds: one little garden of carefully separated flower beds and a closed indigo notebook, one world with a delicate brass telescope and a little open notebook, one world with neatly arranged small blank paper cards. The traveler gazes toward them with quiet curiosity. Use restrained translucent washes, subtle cold-pressed paper texture, pale ultramarine, dusty teal, ochre, and a tiny terracotta accent. Fine imperfect ink outlines, sparse golden stars, generous clean negative space. The worlds and traveler must feel tender and hand-painted, never plastic or like 3D render. Compose as a wide landscape editorial illustration, approximately 16:9, all important content inside generous margins and concentrated in the lower two thirds, balanced airy composition suitable for a cream-background documentation page. Art only: no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no code, no diagram arrows. Original scene, do not reproduce an existing cover or book illustration. Opaque warm ivory background.
